items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: I said yes even though I had never played any dixieland band. Ory was quite successful in his comeback as a leader

ctx.x: Mr. Blakeney, were you living on Parmalee then?
I was still living on Parmalee--12117 Parmalee Avenue. I said yes even though I had never played any dixieland band. Ory was quite successful in his comeback as a leader
and he had a lot of work lined up.
